evaluations.model_answer:
Verlaufen IWF-Fiskalindex und Schuldenquote im linken Diagramm gleichlaeufig oder gegenlaeufig, und ab wann aendert sich die Beziehung?**

The IWF Fiscal Index (blue line) and the Schuldenquote (debt ratio) (red line) in the left diagram initially move *counter-cyclically* (gegenläufig).  From roughly 1995 to 2010, as the debt ratio rises (red line goes up), the IWF Fiscal Index tends to fall (blue line goes down).  After 2010, the relationship seems to shift and becomes more *aligned* (gleichläufig). The debt ratio continues to rise, and the IWF Fiscal Index also tends to rise, though less steadily. The change seems to begin around 2010-2015.
